item.summary: fix(ui): Enter-send wedges dead when IME composition is abandoned via blur (#123249) Browsers can drop compositionend (element detach or blur mid-IME). composerComposing persists across renders in the pane state map, so a stuck flag killed Enter-send, input history keys, and command menus until the Send button — which force-resets the flag — was clicked. handleBlur was a half-repair of this invariant: it cleared the composingDraft shadow state but not the flag. Clear both.
